context_for_next_testing_agent: MF Benchmark Rating feature fully implemented and tested. The fund-performance endpoint fetches 1Y historical NAV from mfapi.in for up to 30 funds (with semaphore-limited async requests). It computes benchmark ratings as: return > category_avg + 2% = overperforming, return < category_avg - 2% = underperforming, else = meeting. The alpha value = fund_return - benchmark_return. InsightsView now has 5 tabs. Test user has 68 mutual funds with 30 matched to AMFI data. Performance distribution shows 12 overperforming, 32 meeting, 6 underperforming, 18 no_data.
